candidates.classification: Current source-level aggregate admission question with a symbolic mismatched-decision construction; the inspected native caller supplies matching authority and no unauthorized product action is established.
candidates.trace: preparation_rights_question builds an actor, object, Alter operation and place question. decide_preparation_rights records its canonical question digest and supplied evidence revision in an allowed decision when the supplied custody flag is true. PreparationPlanAuthority exposes coordinates, snapshot, expected revision, rights and prerequisite booleans independently. build_preparation_plan converts the rights decision only to kind == Allowed; it does not compare the decision provenance to the coordinates or expected revision. For a symbolic trusted caller, an allowed decision for actor A, object 1, place P can be supplied with otherwise admitted coordinates for actor A, object 2, place P, all prerequisite booleans true and a nonterminal finite clock interval. The generic builder then sees satisfied requirements and the completed-time branch emits CommitPreparation. No hash collision, actual persisted state or external caller is needed for the observation that the planner never compares those inputs.
candidates.commit_and_comparison: The generic validate_commit checks the attempt, snapshot and equality of the two plans including coordinates, requirement checks, time and effects. The preparation plan stores only the resulting rights-kind boolean in requirements, not the decision provenance, so equality alone does not establish a binding if the same mismatch were supplied in both plans. The separately inspected foraging adapter uses ForageLicenseDecision::try_new to compare its question digest before retaining a decision; that is evidence of a different boundary contract, not proof that both domains must use identical types.
candidates.actual_adapter_safeguards: At the only non-test build_preparation_plan call found by a full tracked-tree text search, load_preparation_authority checks the lot revision, inventory row, stable object identity, actor-carried custody, preparation transition and tool. The native builder makes coordinates and a rights question from the same actor, object and place, and gives the decision the lot material revision. The reducer checks canonical request inputs, reloads authority, replans, validates the material receipt and reloads after waiting before mutating the lot. These are meaningful safeguards; this trace does not show that an untrusted user can supply the mismatched decision or that a production authorization failure occurs. The correct relationship between rights evidence revision and material/snapshot revision is a design question, not assumed universal equality.
candidates.connected_repair: First decide whether the planner is intentionally an unchecked trusted-adapter interface or should own a checked aggregate binding of the decision to the exact actor, object, place and relevant evidence revision. If the latter, bind the admitted decision and preserve existing fresh-custody, material-conservation, clock-interruption and replay checks; trace all adapters and callers before changing contracts. No compatibility shim or second authority path.
candidates.later_acceptance: After implementation and product validation are separately authorized, cover valid matched decisions, mismatched actor/object/place, stale relevant evidence, denied rights, fresh reload and interrupted versus completed preparation. Preserve the legitimate native custody and material safeguards.
